title: Core Course Cover System
description: Four reference-dependent images define a kids course-cover family across a master brand cover and three subject modules.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes the cover architecture, illustration ratio, badge logic, and palette system. Images 02-04 preserve the same educational-brand cover language while switching subject matter.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-reference-master-cover first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-art-adventure-cover, 03-junior-coding-cover, 04-science-discovery-cover. Queue may run those images concurrently after 01-reference-master-cover is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
